why: State cycle 1 (docs/v3/cycles/state-1.md, P2 state-1.14): at 1800 px the FilterSet draws the full pill row and, under it, the narrow form's `Filters` button, on `/cycle-state` and on `/overview` alike. The row shows from `@regular` and the button's wrapper hides from `@regular`, but the two resolve against different containers, so both forms show. Shots: `.evidence/v3-shots/state-1/cycle-state*--1800x1200.png` in the cycle's worktree; reproduce with `bun apps/playground/scripts/shots.ts /overview`.
what: One FilterSet form at any width.
owns: a layout test and fixture under packages/basalt-ui/tests/layout/
change: Put the row and the narrow `Filters` button under the same `@container`, so `@regular:flex` and `@regular:hidden` read one width. A layout test mounts a FilterSet of four specs in a `Page` at 1800 and 390 px and asserts exactly one of the two forms is visible at each width.
acceptance: At 1800 px only the pill row is visible; at 390 px only the Filters button (layout test)
out_of_scope: Reset all on the desktop row (v3-state-1-state); DataTable cells at 390 px (v3-expr-2-kit-fixes).
